headline: Suprajit Engineering signs a solar power purchase agreement
hook: Renewable energy push at Suprajit Engineering
summary: Suprajit Engineering has informed stock exchanges about entering into a solar power purchase agreement. The company will source solar energy for its operations, potentially lowering its long-term energy costs. Such green energy adoption helps manufacturing firms hedge against rising conventional power tariffs. Indian retail investors should note this operational cost-efficiency measure in an auto-ancillary player.
why_it_matters: Green power adoption may lower long-term operating costs.
